tasks.q: How much are Wool Runners at allbirds.com right now? Reply one short line with the price.

codex.sample: Wool Runners are $110 USD at Allbirds. [Source](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-woo

cost_usd.note: CORRECTION 2026-08-29: the mean recorded here was 1, because stats() in evals/ab/arm-agents.mjs applied Math.round to it (right for ms, wrong for dollars). The script is fixed (Number(x.toFixed(4))) but the agents were NOT re-run. Per-run costs were never persisted, so min/max/n are the only exact values; for n=3 the mean is bounded by (2*min+max)/3 and (min+2*max)/3, recorded above. See docs/measurements/2026-08-29-ab.md.
